fichas.title: Guidelines for road noise protection
fichas.summary: Road traffic noise can be mitigated with earth banks, noise-reduction walls, and noise-reduction pyramids. The mitigation effect depends mainly on barrier height and the resulting noise shadow; some sound bends around the barrier. The text gives categories for reflecting and absorbing walls and refers to RLS-81 for calculation methods.
uses: Reduce road traffic noise at nearby buildings
Shield residential areas from traffic noise
furniture_equipment: Glass, timber, and steel barrier components

fichas.title: Roadside noise-barrier forms and construction
fichas.summary: The illustrated measures include earth banks, walls, a wall in a house garden, a protection wall made from concrete blocks, and pyramid or wall-shaped precast noise barriers. The height and configuration of barriers are illustrated in section; the diagrams also show a standard road barrier arrangement and barrier-height determination relative to a road and housing.
uses: Screen nearby buildings from road noise

fichas.title: Noise levels, distance reduction, and barrier performance
fichas.summary: The page provides diagrams and tables for planned sound levels by area, noise reduction with distance, noise reduction by barrier height, and approximate road-traffic noise estimation by traffic loading and distance from the road centre. The isophone diagram depicts noise levels around a road, an earth bank, and a noise-shielding wall.
